data.title: Monaco vs Freiburg Prediction, Betting Tips, Lineups & Odds | 22 Oct 2026
Monaco vs Freiburg prediction, preview & betting tips – 22/10/2026
data.content:
Monaco and Freiburg return to action in the Conference League when they go head to head at the Stade Louis II on Thursday evening. Both sides kicked off their European quest with narrow victories last week, with Monaco getting the better of CSKA Sofia in Bulgaria, while Freiburg edged out Jablonec on home turf.

Read our Monaco vs Freiburg preview, while you can also find more of our expert predictions on today's betting tips page.

## Monaco vs Freiburg key stats [...] This followed a dominant team display in the qualifying playoffs, where Filipe Luis’s men secured a 7-3 aggregate victory over Gornik Zabrze, claiming a 3-2 first-leg victory in Poland on August 20, one week before securing a more convincing 4-1 second-leg victory at the Stade Louis II.

Over in Germany, Freiburg also picked up a dream start to the Conference League campaign last Thursday when they held on to see out a 3-2 win over a resilient Jablonec side at the Europa-Park Stadion. [...] A seventh-placed finish in the Bundesliga standings last season saw Freiburg book their spot in the Europa qualifying playoffs, where they thrashed Scottish side Motherwell 7-2 on aggregate to seal a first appearance in Europe’s third-tier club competition.
